name: Fast Splat Sorting
aliases: Fast Splat Sorting — Split Radix Sort for Splatting
definition: A sorting algorithm that splits the 48-bit radix sort of m splat fragments into a 32-bit radix sort of n splats and a 16-bit radix sort of m fragments.
summary: Fast Splat Sorting optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by replacing a single 48-bit sort with two smaller, sequential sorts of depth and tile IDs, significantly reducing computational complexity and improving performance.
